implemented_extension.endpoint_domain: arbitrary finite exact rational turns on one pole-free tangent-half branch
implemented_extension.endpoint_construction: x=tan(pi*p/q) is represented by the selected real root of Im((1+i*x)^q), isolated with exact rational Sturm bisection
implemented_extension.endpoint_equality: event polynomial equality at an algebraic endpoint is decided by exact polynomial gcd with the endpoint defining polynomial
implemented_extension.endpoint_sign: non-equality is decided by exact isolating-interval refinement until rational boundary signs are certified constant
implemented_extension.root_count: one-sided Sturm signs at algebraic endpoints give exact open-window root counts

full_blocker_review.reason: Arbitrary rational-turn endpoints are no longer the limiting case for constant-coefficient rational trigonometric polynomials, but the full grammar still includes polynomial/B-spline path/feed terms coupled to trigonometric phase; no unconditional finite exact route for that full grammar is established by this extension.
